articles.title: OCC chief says Democrats applying sole political pressure in World Liberty charter choice
articles.snippet: The regulator rejected claims he's doing President Trump's bidding during a congressional hearing that also addressed the GENIUS Act stablecoin push.

articles.title: CFTC follows SEC in scrapping ‘no-deny’ policy for settlements
articles.snippet: CFTC Chairman Mike Selig says the rescission of its “no-deny” policy means it now has more flexibility when settling enforcement actions.

articles.title: Crypto Billionaires Donate $9.4M to Farage’s Reform UK in Q1
articles.snippet: Tether investor Christopher Harborne and BitMEX co-founder Ben Delo’s outspent Britain's traditional political donors.

articles.title: Mastercard Expands Stablecoin Settlement via Circle's USDC, Ripple's RLUSD and Beyond
articles.snippet: Mastercard said it's deepening its commitment to the "always-on" economy, buffing out its stablecoin settlement capabilities.

articles.title: Zcash Completes 'Most Ambitious' Network Upgrade as ZEC Resumes Recent Surge
articles.snippet: A Zcash vulnerability could have allowed double-spending within the network's flagship privacy pool, though no exploitation occurred.
